generalAbilities.name: Orescent
generalAbilities.description: A mjolgat can detect the ores of unrefined precious metals with its powerful nose. Common earth and stone do not impede the mjolgat from smelling ores deep within the ground.

defensiveAbilities.name: Head On
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature the mjolgat can see targets the mjolgat with an attack

Effect The mjolgat swings its crest in the direction of the danger, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hammerhead
offensiveAbilities.description: The mjolgat rears upon its hind leg to crush an enemy with its jagged crest of bone. The mjolgat makes a bone crest Strike; on a hit, the mjolgat deals an extra die of damage. This counts as two attacks when calculating the mjolgat's multiple attack penalty

offensiveAbilities.name: Punch-Drunk
offensiveAbilities.description: If the mjolgat critically fails a bone crest Strike, it becomes Stunned 1 and Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rockbreaker
offensiveAbilities.description: When the mjolgat deals damage to an object (such as a shield or an ore deposit), it deals double damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shrieking Slam
offensiveAbilities.description:
The mjolgat lets out a terrifying screech before bashing its head into the ground. Creatures within 30 feet of the mjolgat must attempt a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save. Regardless of the result of the save, they are then immune to Shrieking Slam.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Frightened 1.

Failure The target is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The target is Frightened 3 and Fleeing for 1 round.
